d: Bihar men varsh 2016 se purn sharabbandi kanun lagu hai, lekin rajdhani patna ke sabse surakshit aur haee-prophail ilakon se lagatar aa rahi khabren sharabbandi ke davon par bare saval khare kar rahi hain. hal hi men sachivalay thana kshetr aur mukhyamantri aavas ke najdiki ilakon men sharab ki khali botlen milne ke bad ab ek aur sanasnikhej mamla samne aaya hai. patna sthit viviaaeepi emaelsi kvartar (MLC Quarters) parisar ke kuen men bhari matra men branded videshi sharab aur biyar ki khali botlen tairti najar aaee hain. is khabar ke samne aate hi prashasnik mahakme men harkanp mach gaya…
